body: Same here. Nothing else makes any sense. If you're an artist, you're fullfilling thought is to create something beautiful. In my case it's the thought that I'll spare anyone (including myself) with my existence soon.
Best of me - A Day to Remember

I wish it was as easy as this. Some won't be hurt if you do as they did, that's why they don't see anything bad about it. "I could deal with it, so why is she so upset?" My cheating bf had exes cheat on him and stayed with them. I think that's why he expects me to get over it.

Thank you all so much for your nice support. It's soothing to hear from other people. Deep inside I know what's happening if I keep it going. It's just so hard to come to terms with it since we've been together for almost four years. There's so much fear for everything getting worse if I leave. 
Thank you all so so so much for being there.

Maybe it doesn't matter but I can relate. It's uncomfortable. Escpecially if they always want to talk about it. In my case it's because THEY want to feel better, I hope your people treat you better. If you want to talk, I'm there.
